# Signs: {a} cursive a-shaped sign; {phi} looped p-like sign; {d} delta-like sign; {c} hooked c-like sign; {mu} mu-like sign;
# {x} x-like sign; {E} E-like sign; {z} 2/ℓ-like sign; {s} long-s-like sign; {b} b-like sign (in vitae).
# gloss = interlinear decipherment in Ludwig Camerarius's hand as read here ("-" none).
# reading: plain = the frozen key gives it; <word> = the cipher departs from the key and the reading is the gloss (counted read, listed);
# [?word] = doubtful, counted not read; [...] = not read.
